enabled.name: Enable TBG bubbles
enabled.hint: Master switch for the bubbles in the band at the top of the screen (the tokens' speech, speech with no token and the sheet action bubble) and for the typing badge. The narrator bubble has its own switch. The chat bar and the scene history keep working.

debug.name: Debug logging
debug.hint: Print verbose TBG logs to the browser console. This client only.

bubbleLayout.name: Bubble stacking
bubbleLayout.hint: Free flow: a new bubble only pushes the bubbles it touches, so whoever speaks far away gets their own column. Line by line: every new bubble pushes the whole band.

bubbleRiseSpeed.name: Rise speed
bubbleRiseSpeed.hint: Average screen pixels per second that bubbles rise. They rise in hops, one line at a time: at the default, 15, that is about one hop every two seconds. Zero keeps them in place until newer bubbles push them.

bubbleBandHeight.name: Bubble band height
bubbleBandHeight.hint: Distance, in pixels, from the top of the screen to the line where bubbles appear. They rise from there to the top and fade out.

bubbleMaxLifetime.name: Maximum lifetime
bubbleMaxLifetime.hint: Seconds before a bubble fades wherever it is. Zero disables the limit: a bubble only fades when it passes the top of the screen. The narrator bubble always stays at least 30 seconds.

bubblePortrait.name: Portrait in bubbles
bubblePortrait.hint: Show the token image inside the bubble, next to the name.

typingIndicator.name: Show who is typing
typingIndicator.hint: While someone writes in the chat bar, an ellipsis badge appears in the corner of their token. It disappears when the message is sent, when the input loses focus, or after three seconds without typing, even if text is left in the input.

usageBubbles.name: Sheet action bubbles
usageBubbles.hint: When someone uses an item, a feature or a roll from their sheet, in any system, a beige bubble appears above the token's position: "Kirito used Longsword". Only the action's name, never the result.

narrationBanner.name: Narrator bubble
narrationBanner.hint: Every GM narration shows, for everyone, as a black bubble with white text in the middle of the bubble band, in the same format as the players' bubbles. It hops more slowly than the others, to stay at least 30 seconds when nothing pushes it. When off, narration only goes to the scene history.

narratorName.name: Narrator name
narratorName.hint: Name shown on narration messages. Leave empty for "Narrator".

narratorActive.name: Narrator mode
narratorActive.hint: Whether this client is currently narrating.

chatTheme.name: Chat theme
chatTheme.hint: Author portrait and color on the roll cards of the chat sidebar. This client only.

migration.name: TBG data version
migration.hint: How far TBG has updated this world.

Bar.label: Chat bar
Bar.placeholder: Type here and press Enter to speak…
Bar.narrating: Narrating as {name}, with Narrator mode on. Click to turn it off.
Bar.narratingNoToken: Narrating as {name}: no token selected. Select a token to speak as it, or click to narrate with a token too.
Bar.offCharacter: Out of character: select your token to speak as it.
Bar.focusHint: Moves the cursor to the chat bar at the bottom of the screen, to type without the mouse.

History.title: Scene history
History.empty: Nobody has spoken in this scene yet.
History.older: {count} older lines are left out; the export has them all.
History.eraseContent: The {count} selected lines will be deleted for good, for everyone. This cannot be undone.

Guard.title: Speak as a player character?
Guard.question: The GM usually does not speak as a player character. Send it anyway?
Guard.remember: Do not ask again for this character until the page reloads

Narrator.name: Narrator
Narrator.toggleHint: Plain text you send is posted as the Narrator even with a token selected. With no token, the GM always narrates.
Narrator.on: Narrator mode on: plain messages are posted as the Narrator, even with a token selected.
Narrator.off: Narrator mode off: with a token selected you speak as it; with no token, you keep narrating.

Migration.tabsContent: TBG now keeps only rolls and cards in the chat sidebar; conversation goes to the bar at the bottom of the screen and to the Scene history. The Custom Chat Tabs tabs are no longer needed. Turn Enable Chat Tabs off now? Foundry reloads the page.

menu.name: Player guide
menu.label: Create guide journal
menu.hint: Creates the "Guia do TBG" journal in this world, a Portuguese tutorial on playing by text with one page per module feature, visible to players. The GM pages stay hidden from them. If the guide already exists, its pages are replaced with the current version.

Guide.title: TBG guide
Guide.confirm: Create or update the "Guia do TBG" journal in this world? If it already exists, its pages are replaced with the current version of the guide; the journal's folder and permissions stay as they are.
Guide.created: TBG guide created in the journal.
Guide.updated: TBG guide updated in the journal.

Errors.noSpeaker: Select a token or assign a character before speaking in character.
